summary: Olga Coal Company tower in McDowell County, one of three; standing on private land, administered by Alawest; build date not found in sources read.

access.note: NHLR lists the site as private land; no visiting arrangement is given.

events.note: Newspaper report describes an observer at the Olga Fire Tower; the report does not say which of the three Olga towers it means

notes_for_editor: No build year for Olga No. 2 was found. The 1986 Bluefield Daily Telegraph report on Forest Lookouts does not name which Olga tower it describes (No. 1, No. 2 or No. 3), so it is not treated as a fact about No. 2. Olga No. 1 facts are from its own site record and are marked as such. Olga and Huff Knob have no Wikipedia article at the titles tried. The Wriston article PDF may cover the Olga towers; fetch_text returned no text for it. Administrator Alawest is named only by the NHLR and the sister site records.
